player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwenye umdlalo weHighSociety (uhlobo lwe-2 abadlali).
Ukuhamba kwenye umdlalo:  Ikhadi ezishumi zobugqwangu zitakalishwa emva kwenye enye.
Ukunyathelisa:    Kwenye ukalisho ngalinye, khetha ngokusesikweni ikhadi yemali 1-11 baze uyiveze.
            • Inyathelo ephakamileyo inqoba ikhadi yobugqwangu baze iyichithe ikhadi leyo yemali.
            • Inyathelo ephantsi inabakhilela ikhadi yabo yemali.
            • Ithi -> zombini zinyathelo zibuyiselwe baze ikhadi leyo yobugqwangu ikalishwe kwakhona.
Ukubala:    Emva kwekalisho zonke ezishumi, ongeza **imali esalileyo + amaponti abugqwangu**.
            Inet-worth ephakamileyo inqoba (ithi elinganayo -> yahlule). 

**Isivakalisi sesenzo**  →  nyathela ikhadi ngokwee '[7]' okanye '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kufuneka ibandakanye kanye ikhadi elinye [X] lemali.

message.auction_result: P0 inyathela {bid0}, P1 inyathela {bid1}. Mdlali {winner} unqoba ukuhlonipha {prize} (jikelele {total}).
